title: Looking for character artists for published and upcoming books

author: Sega Jenesis
title: Hiring digital artists for custom Pokémon binder scenes
content: 🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀 I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. 💚 If you’re an artist or know someone who might be interested, please send them my way! I’d love to see portfolios, pricing, and availability. 🥰 Contact via comments or DMs on Threads.

title: Seeking character artists for 2 full body characters under £300

author: Emma Goldstein
title: Calling artists for character art on self-published novel, no AI
content: Alright artists- I'm putting out a call. I am self publishing my novel in the next year and am looking for someone to do some character art for me for my two main characters. I want to make something very clear - ABSOLUTELY NO AI USAGE IN ANY PART OF THE PROCESS. I got burned badly earlier this year by someone who told me they didn't use AI but after I paid her, she 100% used AI. I don't want that. I'm willing to pay an actual artist, not a robot. So pitch yourself in the comments!

author: not_ordr
title: Looking for character artist for upcoming book with flexible payment
content: I'm looking for an artists that can do character art for my up coming book. And who's willing to work with me because money is tight. So a lot up front wouldn't work but I can definitely pay you what you're worth. Just not up front. No AI please. I am so fucking serious no AI please! Contact via comments or DMs on Threads.
